newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE 213-7 AT TEA AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE 213-7 AT TEA AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Free State, chasing an unlikely 472 to win from a minimum of 130 overs, were 213 for seven in their second innings at tea on the final day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Monday.
Natal 282 (Dale Benkenstein 100, Neil Johnson 50) and 349 for seven declared (Derek Crookes 52, Jonty Rhodes 156 not out).
Free State 160 (Boeta Dippenaar 81) and 213 for seven in 98 overs (Deon Jordaan 81, Boeta Dippenaar 52 not out).
